description: Why: metrics that are registered but never incremented waste memory and confuse dashboards with permanently-zero series that imply the feature is working with no activity rather than absent. What: metrics.rs registers GOSSIP_MESSAGES_PUBLISHED_TOTAL and GOSSIP_MESSAGES_DROPPED_TOTAL (gossipsub was removed from the codebase) and IPFS_WRITE_LATENCY_SECONDS (histogram is never observed in the ingestion pipeline). Remove all three registrations or wire the latency histogram to the IPFS write path.
title: Dead Prometheus metrics: gossip_messages_published_total, gossip_messages_dropped_total, ipfs_write_latency_seconds
